flagged.title: Spain in 1490: Crusading Spirit and Foreign Ambitions
flagged.reason: F2 is mark_affecting because the video states Torquemada led the Inquisition upon its founding in 1478 and incorrectly defines conversos as including Muslim converts, which directly contradicts the lesson definition and mark scheme.

mark_affecting.quote: they founded the Spanish Inquisition in 1478, led by Tomás de Torquemada. Their main target at this time was a group called the conversos. These were Jews and Muslims who had converted to Christianity.
